evidence: ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/Print Center.app/Contents/Info.plist (document type Docs, viewer; widget extension PrintCenterWidgetExtension.macOS.appex; Metadata.appintents)

ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/Print Center.app/Contents/MacOS/Print Center (strings: menus Pause/Resume Selected Job(s), Pause/Resume/Remove/Forget/Get Info for printer, pool, shared printer, fax; notifications PKJobListNotification, PKPrinterListChangedNotification, PCPrinterOfflineStateChangedNotification, PCCancelPrintJobNotification; PrintCenterDropDelegate; state reasons media-jam, marker-supply-low)

features.apple: Window lists every printer, fax and shared printer with name and status line (Printer Column Title)
features.note: One row per queue with state, Default flag and queued-job count.

features.apple: JobsListView shows the jobs of the chosen printer
features.note: Header with name and detail, columns id, name, user, size, state.

features.apple: Pause Printer / Resume Printer menu items and row button (localizedPauseString, localizedResumeString)
features.note: One toolbar button flips between Pause and Resume from the printer state.

features.apple: Default printer label and menu choice
features.note: Set Default is enabled only for a non-default printer.

features.apple: Remove Printer menu item with a delete confirmation (DeleteConfirmation, delete printer with this name)
features.note: Delete Printer needs a second press (Confirm Delete); choosing another printer drops it.

features.apple: Add Printer menu item opens the printer browser with discovered, nearby and address entries
features.note: Still the clipboard address only (Cmd+N); no discovery list, name or location fields: needs an mDNS browse in the cups client.
features.wire: Add a Discover sheet to window.rs listing mDNS (_ipp._tcp) and USB devices from bifrost_app::controls::cups, with name, location and protocol fields, behind the Add Printer button; keep the clipboard path as a fallback.

features.apple: Cancel Print Job (PCCancelPrintJobNotification), job context menu Remove
features.note: Cancel Job is enabled while the job still occupies the queue.

features.apple: Pause Selected Job (job-hold-until)
features.note: Hold applies to a waiting job.

features.apple: Resume Selected Job
features.note: Release applies to a held job.

features.apple: Pause Selected Jobs, Resume Selected Jobs (plural menu items); jobs list selects many
features.note: Drag over rows or Select All Jobs (Cmd+A) choose many; Hold, Release and Cancel run over every chosen job (model.rs:68). Pointer clicks carry no Shift or Cmd state in the SDK, so no click-modifier selection.
features.wire: Change Model.selected_job to a BTreeSet<i32> (model.rs:49), extend Target::Job with shift and cmd modifiers in window.rs:295 and run the job action over every selected id in worker.rs Request::Act.

features.apple: Contextual menu on a job: pause, resume, remove
features.note: Hold, Release, Cancel and Select All Jobs on a secondary click, wired in main.rs through Input::Context.
features.wire: Add a secondary-click Target::Job handler in window.rs:295 that opens the shell context menu (bifrost_app::controls menu kit) with Hold, Release and Cancel mapped to toolbar_action (window.rs:339).

features.apple: Contextual menu on a printer: Get Info, Pause, Remove, Forget
features.note: Pause or Resume, Set as Default, Printer Info, Share or Stop Sharing, Remove Printer on a secondary click.
features.wire: Add a secondary-click Target::Printer menu in window.rs:295 with Pause or Resume, Set Default, Delete Printer, Printer Info.

features.apple: JobCellView shows a preview image (JobThumbnailImageChangedNotification, jobImageURL)
features.note: Rows are text only.
features.wire: Request job-preview or the first-page raster through cups::Client (bifrost_app::controls::cups) in worker.rs, cache it per job id in Model and draw a 24 pt thumbnail left of the name in draw.rs:79.

features.apple: Job cell progress indicator and Canceling page N status (jobProgress)
features.note: Progress bar under a printing job's status and Printing N of M text (model.rs:458); depends on the scheduler reporting job-media-progress or impressions.
features.wire: Read job-media-progress and job-impressions-completed in worker.rs Request::List and draw a progress bar under the state cell in draw.rs:79.

features.apple: Waiting, Held, Printing, Stopped, Canceled, Failed, Completed plus reasons (Paused on server, Canceled on server)
features.note: Status column appends reasons such as Canceled on server and Held for authentication (model.rs:440).
features.wire: Add job-state-reasons to the Job model and append the reason to job_state_name (model.rs:161): cups-remote-canceled, cups-remote-stopped, job-hold-until-specified, Hold for Authentication.

features.apple: Job cell: title, owner, size, state, date
features.note: Pages and Created columns added (draw.rs:15).
features.wire: Add Created and Pages columns to HEADINGS and columns() (window.rs:212) from time-at-creation and job-media-sheets.

features.apple: Plain messages for state reasons: paper jam, out of paper, tray missing, door open, offline, may be out of toner
features.note: Plain sentences with a warning mark under the printer name (draw.rs:98) and in the info pane.
features.wire: Map printer-state-reasons to sentences in model.rs (printer_detail, model.rs:187) for media-jam, media-empty, media-needed, toner-low, marker-supply-empty, offline-report, door-open and show them under the printer name with a warning glyph.

features.apple: Ink and toner levels from marker-supply-low and marker-supply-empty
features.note: Level bars in the info pane from marker-names, levels and colors (springboard/ui/src/cups.rs:294).
features.wire: Read marker-names, marker-levels, marker-colors in worker.rs, add Printer.supplies in model.rs and draw level bars in a Supplies section of draw.rs:79.

features.apple: PCPrinterOfflineStateChangedNotification greys out an unreachable printer
features.note: TCP probe with a 1 s timeout on a thread per device; the row is dimmed and marked Offline. USB and local devices are not probed.
features.wire: Probe reachability of the device URI in worker.rs (TCP connect with 1 s timeout) every POLL_MS, store Printer.offline and dim the row in draw.rs:56 with an Offline summary word.

features.apple: Get Info and PrintCenterOptionsView: name, location, driver, supplies, sharing
features.note: Info pane (Cmd+I) edits description and location and saves through cups set_printer_details; lists model, address, supplies and sharing. No driver or option editing.
features.wire: Add an Info sheet reached from the toolbar (new B_INFO id in window.rs:33) editing printer-info and printer-location via cups::Client set-printer-attributes, with the supply list.

features.apple: Printer pool rows with Pause, Resume, Remove Printer Pool
features.note: Pools are listed with their members and removed as pools (springboard/ui/src/cups.rs:509); pause and resume go to the class name. Creating a pool is not offered.
features.wire: List class entries from cups::Client get-classes alongside printers in model.rs and route pause, resume and delete to the class name; draw members in the detail header.

features.apple: Shared printer rows with their own pause, resume and remove items
features.note: Shared flag shown in rows and the info pane; Share Printer or Stop Sharing in the menu and context menu. Remote queues from other hosts are not told apart.
features.wire: Flag printers with printer-is-shared or a remote URI in model.rs and offer Stop Sharing in the Info sheet.

features.apple: Fax Column Title and fax menu variants
features.note: BifrOSt has no fax stack.

features.apple: Forget Printer removes the queue and its cloud account suggestion
features.note: Depends on the vendor cloud account.

features.apple: PrintCenterDropDelegate and PrintDocuments: drop files on the window or Dock icon to print them
features.note: Input::Open and the Print Document panel send the file to the selected printer as its own type (model.rs mime_for); the scheduler converts. No document-to-PDF pipeline of our own.
features.wire: Accept Input::Drop files in main.rs:26, convert through the document pipeline to PDF and submit with cups::Client print-job to the selected printer (new Request::Print in worker.rs).

features.apple: PKPrinterListChangedNotification, PKJobListNotification, PKJobProgressNotification push changes
features.note: Lists again every 5 s while open, and at once after an action.
features.wire: Subscribe to scheduler events (cupsSubscribeEvents / ipp Create-Printer-Subscriptions) in worker.rs and send Reply::Changed so the list refreshes within a second instead of POLL_MS (window.rs:30).

features.feature: Dock badge and bounce for a stalled job
features.apple: Print Center icon appears in the Dock while a job prints and shows the job count
features.note: Badge shows waiting jobs while the app is running (main.rs tick). The app is not launched in the background and does not bounce.
features.wire: Publish queued_jobs from worker.rs to the shell dock model (springboard/src/shell) as a badge and launch the app in the background while a job is active.

features.apple: Notification when a printer needs attention (out of paper, jam)
features.note: An error-level printer reason posts one notification until it clears (model.rs:128); only while the app runs.
features.wire: Post a shell notification from worker.rs when printer-state-reasons gains an error-level reason, using the notification centre API.

features.apple: PrintCenterWidgetExtension shows printer status on the desktop
features.note: No widget.
features.wire: Add a printers widget to the widgets host reading the same Model through the app control socket.

features.apple: Metadata.appintents actions (print documents, cancel job)
features.note: Control methods printers.list, printers.jobs, printers.pause, printers.resume, printers.cancel_job; no Shortcuts action registration or print-documents method yet.
features.wire: Expose list, pause, resume, cancel as app control methods (bifrost-app-control) so Shortcuts can call them.

features.apple: Toolbar buttons reachable by the screen reader and keyboard
features.note: Toolbar controls are published and answer Input::Activate.

features.apple: Automatic termination with no unsaved state
features.note: Sudden termination is enabled.

features.apple: Print Center Help
features.note: No Help item for this app.
features.wire: Register a Help topic page for the app in the Help book registry and bind it to the menu bar Help item.
